name: slide-1-subtitle
text: One system removes fragile synchronization between the storefront and CRM
textPreview: One system removes fragile synchronization between the storefront and CRM

name: customer-side-body
text: Learners need a clear catalogue, trusted reviews, quick purchase and simple tutoring reservations.
textPreview: Learners need a clear catalogue, trusted reviews, quick purchase and simple tutoring reservations.

name: business-side-body
text: The company needs leads, purchases, invoices, analytics and corporate clients in one operational view.
textPreview: The company needs leads, purchases, invoices, analytics and corporate clients in one operational view.

name: integration-gap-body
text: Separate tools create duplicate or inconsistent data and require slow manual reconciliation.
textPreview: Separate tools create duplicate or inconsistent data and require slow manual reconciliation.

name: problem-statement
text:
PROBLEM STATEMENT
Use one application and one shared data model so each customer action is captured once and drives the relevant CRM processes automatically.
One system. Two role-based experiences. No manual reconciliation.

text: Existing tools solve parts of the problem, not the whole workflow

name: related-work-intro
text: Each tool family covers one side well; none unifies a course storefront and a CRM in a single product.

name: related-work-takeaway
text: TrainingIT unifies both sides on one shared data model and specializes CRM workflows for training: sessions, calendars, tutoring, discounts and course analytics.

text: A working product: storefront and CRM operate as one system
textPreview: A working product: storefront and CRM operate as one system

name: applied-contribution-body
text: TrainingIT combines a course marketplace and CRM in one Java web application. Each customer action is stored once and drives event-based workflows; the Claude AI layer remains optional.

name: objectives-list
text:
Learner portal: browse, buy, review and book tutoring.
Admin portal with seven management tabs.
Event-driven domain automation.
Optional, fault-tolerant AI assistant.
Operational and CRM data in MariaDB.

text:
Not a general-purpose e-commerce platform or CRM.

A focused training-company system: learner storefront plus a CRM a small team can run, with AI strictly additive.

name: ai-feature-1-body
text: Answers questions about courses, enrolment and corporate training using the live catalogue as context.
textPreview: Answers questions about courses, enrolment and corporate training using the live catalogue as context.

name: ai-feature-2-body
text: Matches a visitor's interests, level and goal to courses, each with a fit score and a reason.
textPreview: Matches a visitor's interests, level and goal to courses, each with a fit score and a reason.

name: ai-feature-3-body
text: Analyses employee roles and interests to propose a training programme for a whole team.
textPreview: Analyses employee roles and interests to propose a training programme for a whole team.

name: ai-feature-4-body
text: Translates the interface while preserving brand names, people, e-mails and numbers.
textPreview: Translates the interface while preserving brand names, people, e-mails and numbers.

name: ai-implementation-note
text: All four features share one Claude client and one API key. The prompts, REST endpoints, structured JSON handling and matching interfaces are isolated so the application remains fully operational when AI is not configured.
